editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text and rulebook text are never copied; rules and news are explained in Swoon'd's own words with section pointers or links to the original.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a tennis match or a Grand Slam, understand the score, the serve and why a break matters, ask a couple of good questions about a shot or a surface, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Procedural or original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no third-party player or event photos without a written license.
No broadcast audio; sim audio is original or synthesised (original-swoond).
ATP, WTA, ITF, Grand Slam, Wimbledon, Davis Cup, Laver Cup, tournament and racquet-brand marks are trademarks: text mentions and link-outs only, no logos or tournament artwork.
No embedded broadcast video; deep-link to official streams.
Never copy publisher or rulebook text; paraphrase with section pointers and link.

No free official public tennis API assumed; licensed provider or curated public facts with attribution. Jeff Sackmann tennis datasets are CC BY-NC-SA and must not be used in production. UTR needs a partner agreement; OpenStreetMap needs ODbL attribution.
Names as facts only; no likeness, endorsement implication or fabricated quotes. Anti-doping and legal storylines explain process only, never verdicts.

safetyConstraints: Injury and fitness content stays generic (warm up, stop if it hurts, see a professional); no medical claims.
Heat and hydration mentions stay generic; never coach playing through heat illness.
Etiquette and line-call scenarios teach de-escalation; never coach confrontation.
Never encourage the learner to fake a skill level or expertise with the person they care about.
